name: Invincible Vs.: Ella Mental - Diamond Skin
summary:
Time to shatter the competition.

Harness the brilliance and strength of the planet's rarest gems with the Diamond Skin for Ella Mental. This costume turns Ella into a shimmering force of nature, forged from the extreme heat of blazing fire and the immense pressure of manipulated earth. In this look, Ella doesn’t just control the elements, she showcases their ultimate structural perfection.

Diamonds are forever— but with this Skin, your opponents sure won't be. Shine bright and strike hard.

Included with this Skin are 4 color variants.
